- A confidentiality log will be created and maintained for this case.
- Jules's dated log of three meetings is now formally cited and will be reviewed as part of the intake process.

I'd like to confirm with each of you: are there any additional formal disclosures or process considerations that need to be on record before I finalize this restructuring plan? Once I've confirmed that all disclosures are captured, I'll document the revised process and schedule the separate intake meetings accordingly.
